message.content: - 单个罪名: [罪名]故意毁坏财物罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on facts: The defendant Liu broke into a house, used a crowbar (撅头) and ladder, smashed the door, and destroyed property (TVs, fridge, etc.) valued at 8817 yuan. This is property damage. In Chinese criminal law, this would be "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property). Also possibly "入室抢劫" but no theft, just damage. So the crime is "故意毁坏财物罪". Also could be "非法侵入住宅罪"? Under Chinese law, illegal entry into a dwelling is "非法侵入住宅罪". However the main act is destroying property. The prosecution likely charges "故意毁坏财物罪". The fact that they had a compensation agreement after doesn't affect the crime. So answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物罪<eoa>
